tasks.title: Add a health check endpoint
tasks.why: Summary (2026-01-05, planning notes): the deploy script needs a cheap way to know the service is up.
how: Write a failing test for GET /health
tasks.done_means: GET /health returns 200 and the build id; the test suite passes.

tasks.title: Cache the settings lookup
tasks.why: Summary (2026-01-06): settings are read on every request; profiling shows it is the slowest step.
how: Add a 60 s cache with explicit invalidation
tasks.done_means: p95 request time drops; no stale settings after an update (test proves it).

tasks.title: Write the onboarding guide
tasks.why: Summary (2026-01-06): new people need one page that gets them to a running setup.
how: Have a fresh session follow them
tasks.done_means: A fresh session follows the guide to a working setup without help.
open_questions: Should the guide cover the optional remote runner, or only the core kit?

tasks.title: Rotate the runner key
tasks.why: Summary (2026-01-04): keys are rotated every quarter.
how: Owner creates the new key file
tasks.done_means: ping works with the new key; the old key is refused.

tasks.title: Set up the nightly backup check
tasks.why: Summary (2026-01-02): a backup nobody restores is not a backup.
how: Restore last night's backup into a scratch folder
tasks.done_means: The check runs nightly and reports a pass or a clear failure.
